Aphelios.escape: Engage when Aphelios isn’t holding Severum and can’t apply Gravitum’s slow and root. Aphelios has few ways to create distance on his own, so approach with your allies and catch him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Aphelios.fight: When it’s safe to poke, hit the same target once with Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Check Aphelios’s current and next weapons, and trade when his burst damage is low. If Aphelios isn’t holding Severum and his tools to catch you are down, close the distance with your allies.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with a Gravitum basic attack, immediately move out of range to avoid the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil deals an additional attack when it hits a champion, so spread out from your allies when he can use it. Also back off when marked by a Calibrum attack to avoid the additional hit.
Aphelios.phase: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so prioritize survival and collecting Mist over fighting. In the mid game, make more use of safe poke opportunities as Mist increases your attack damage and range. Late game, use your increased range to find opportunities to land an auto before Aphelios, but stay out of binding range.
Aphelios.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Aphelios’s main damage is physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first. If fights become extended, consider Grievous Wounds after building resistance.
Aphelios.combo: When you get a chance to approach Aphelios, hit him with Senna W Last Embrace first to set up a root, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If it’s hard to land Senna W Last Embrace from that angle, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, focus on gathering mist without getting caught. Before collecting a soul, consider its position and Aphelios’s ability range, and only move forward when his key abilities are down. When poking, follow a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. If you have a Calibrum mark, retreat to preserve your health.
Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from your allies and stay in the backline so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several of you. Heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to basic attack; save Senna W Last Embrace to stop the enemy engage. When there’s an opportunity to go in with your allies, approach with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, and use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that shields your allies.

Alistar.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so getting caught by Alistar once is dangerous; stay alive and gather mist. From mid game onward, mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, giving her more room to poke from a safe position. Late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack, but stay outside Alistar’s engage range.
Alistar.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop Alistar’s engage. Roots applied after Alistar R Unbreakable Will becomes active still work, so if you can’t retreat, root him with Senna W Last Embrace. Target the backline rather than hitting Alistar for too long, and shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Alistar.watch: Alistar W Headbutt can close the gap, then Alistar Q Pulverize can knock you up and Alistar E Trample can stun you, so keep your distance while both abilities are available. Near a turret, don’t give Alistar room to circle behind you and knock Senna toward the turret.
Alistar.build: Alistar has fairly high armor, so consider armor penetration first to deal damage. For defense, build magic resistance against the magic damage from Alistar Q Pulverize, Alistar W Headbutt, and Alistar E Trample. If you’re dying to chained crowd control, prioritize tenacity instead.
Alistar.combo: When Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down, use Senna W Last Embrace to set up a root, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace doesn’t hit, apply the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness first and look for another chance to root him.
Alistar.escape: Right after Alistar dashes in with Alistar W Headbutt, you have a window to regain your distance or engage. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your allies, then use Senna W Last Embrace to lock Alistar down.
Alistar.fight: Right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are used, find your range and make a short trade with Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don’t spend your damage on him; back off and fight again when it ends.
Alistar.laning: Early on, prioritize staying alive and collecting mist over aggressive pokes. Before collecting a soul, check whether Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize have been used, and give up souls in dangerous positions. When it’s safe, pair a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately.

Milio.build: Senna's main physical damage is effective against Milio's low armor, so there's no need to rush armor reduction just because of Milio. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem, get Grievous Wounds earlier. Choose resistances based on the enemy damage dealers’ damage types; magic resistance is more effective than armor against Milio's damage.
Milio.combo: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, approach with your ally and land Senna W Last Embrace. If it's difficult to hit Senna W Last Embrace right away, slow the target first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and aim for the position it will move to.
Milio.escape: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is already down, look for a chance to close the gap. To start a team fight, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your allies and look for Senna W Last Embrace. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is still available, don't overextend for souls or poke.
Milio.fight: From a safe angle, hit the same target with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then immediately back away. If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, look for a chance to close in with your ally and target Milio himself. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root him and follow up on your ally's engage.
Milio.laning: Focus on staying alive and collecting Mist from Senna P Absolution early. Before moving up for a soul, check whether Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, and give up souls in dangerous positions. For poke, combine a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, but don't stand around trying to land repeated basic attacks.
Milio.phase: Senna is weak early, so stay alive, collect Mist, and look for control in lane through safe trades. From mid game onward, Mist increases your attack damage and range, so land the first basic attack from your increased range. In late game, use Senna's range advantage, but Milio's team also gets stronger over time, so put off front line fights while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active.
Milio.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and land basic attacks from your increased range. Follow up with Senna W Last Embrace when an ally engages on Milio, but save the root for an enemy engage if there's a high risk they'll dive you. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that reaches your allies with the shield, and account for the healing and tenacity from Milio R Breath of Life.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and slows its target, so be especially careful when moving up to collect a soul or trade. When Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy marksman's range, don't trade in front; wait for the effect to end.

Braum.combo: If Braum E Unbreakable is down and Braum W Stand Behind Me has been used, hit him with Senna W Last Embrace to set up a root. Overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If there’s no angle to hit with Senna W Last Embrace, apply the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness first.
Braum.phase: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so focus on staying alive and collecting Mist. As your attack damage and range increase from mid game onward, poke from a safe distance; late game, use your increased range to land the first auto.
Braum.build: Senna has no escape ability, so secure tenacity first against the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows. Then build magic resistance against Braum’s magic damage.
Braum.escape: Right after Braum uses Braum W Stand Behind Me is a window to close the distance and look for Senna W Last Embrace. Also check that Braum Q Winter’s Bite or Braum R Glacial Fissure is down before going in, and back off first if Braum P Concussive Blows has marked you.
Braum.fight: Dodge Braum Q Winter’s Bite from behind minions. When it’s safe, pair a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off. If Braum E Unbreakable is active, stop attacking from the front and resume when his shield drops or you get an angle outside its direction.
Braum.laning: Early on, position behind minions so you aren’t facing Braum in a straight line, and repeat short pokes instead of extended trades. Before collecting souls, check Braum’s abilities and distance, and give up souls in dangerous positions.
Braum.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use your increased range to basic attack. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop Braum’s engage. Find an attack angle away from the direction Braum E Unbreakable is facing, and get out of the line of Braum R Glacial Fissure. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield range.
Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter’s Bite or a basic attack marks you with Braum P Concussive Blows, move out of range before the stun triggers. Watch Braum R Glacial Fissure’s cast animation and dodge to the side of its line, and stay out of the lingering slow zone.

Ashe.laning: Early on, focus on gathering mist without dying. Before moving out to collect souls, check whether Ashe W Volley has been used, and give up souls in dangerous positions. Look for safe poke opportunities while avoiding your allied marksman’s last hits.
Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive early. Ashe’s damage is mostly physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: Hit Ashe with Senna W Last Embrace to set up a root, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If it’s hard to land Senna W Last Embrace right away, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no ability to create distance on her own, so there’s an opportunity to engage after Ashe W Volley is used. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is also down, approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, then root her with Senna W Last Embrace.
Ashe.fight: Make a short trade right after Ashe W Volley is used. Hit Ashe with Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. If Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus is active, keep your distance until it ends.
Ashe.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so make short pokes and gather mist without getting caught by Ashe’s slows. From mid game onward, mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, giving her more presence. Late game, use your increased range to basic attack before Ashe from a safe position.
Ashe.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use your increased range to basic attack. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage or to follow up on an allied engage. When going in with your allies, approach with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, and fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so it shields your allies.
Ashe.watch: Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways; it applies a wide slow. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow can stun, so don’t start a small fight from out of vision while her ultimate is available. If it flies toward you, change direction to dodge. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus is active.

Maokai.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of Maokai’s telegraphed attack range. Magic resistance helps against Maokai’s damage, but choose your actual defenses based on the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Senna is caught, and consider tenacity against Maokai’s root.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, set up a root with Senna W Last Embrace, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If there’s no angle to land Senna W Last Embrace first, slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for W.
Maokai.escape: Right after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance, you have a window to close the distance and trade. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp is also down, there’s less risk of being caught, so root him with Senna W Last Embrace and attack.
Maokai.fight: Keep your distance while Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, then move forward for a short trade right after W is down. Don’t use basic attacks or targeted abilities on Maokai while he’s dashing; attack after he lands.
Maokai.laning: Before moving out to collect souls, check whether Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready and whether there are saplings in the bushes, and leave souls in dangerous spots. From a safe angle, hit the enemy carry with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect mist, then back away immediately. Repeatedly hitting Maokai with abilities makes Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing come back sooner, so use your abilities to poke the enemy carry.
Maokai.phase: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so watch for Maokai W Twisted Advance and collect mist without dying. From the mid game onward, use your increased attack damage and range to poke from a safe angle. In the late game, use your longer range to land the first basic attack, but stay out of reach of Maokai’s roots.
Maokai.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range; save Senna W Last Embrace to root Maokai when he engages. Fight in open terrain where there’s room to dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp, and shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow when your team is losing a fight.
Maokai.watch: If Maokai W Twisted Advance catches you, it’s easy for Maokai Q Bramble Smash and Maokai R Nature's Grasp to follow, so don’t close the distance near bushes while W is ready. Don’t enter bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has planted saplings, and dodge Maokai R Nature's Grasp from afar by moving perpendicular to its path.

Soraka.fight: From a safe distance, hit the same target with Senna’s auto and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist from Senna P Absolution, then retreat immediately. When Soraka E Equinox is down, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your ally and target Soraka. Dodging Soraka Q Starcall prevents her from healing and gaining movement speed, letting you keep up the pressure.
Soraka.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox. If fights drag on because of her healing, consider healing reduction next.
Soraka.combo: After Soraka E Equinox is down, approach with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and aim Senna W Last Embrace where Soraka is going. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land immediately, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for W.
Soraka.escape: Once you see Soraka use Soraka E Equinox, you have a chance to engage. Soraka has no mobility ability, but hitting Soraka Q Starcall grants her movement speed, so dodge it before rooting her with Senna W Last Embrace.
Soraka.laning: Early on, collect mist without dying, but watch for Soraka Q Starcall and Soraka E Equinox when moving to collect souls. If you pressure your allied marksman and make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion, Soraka loses health. Avoid minion last hits and poke with basic attacks and Senna Q Piercing Darkness from a safe angle.
Soraka.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so prioritize surviving and collecting mist over risky fights. From the mid game onward, Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, giving her more presence. Late game, use your increased range to land basic attacks first from a safe position.
Soraka.teamfight: While Soraka heals an ally, target Soraka herself instead of continuing to hit only the ally receiving the heal. From the back line, Senna should heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks, while holding Senna W Last Embrace in case the enemy engages. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within its shield area.
Soraka.watch: If Senna is hit by Soraka Q Starcall, she is slowed while Soraka heals and gains movement speed, so dodge it when poking. Soraka E Equinox silences you in its area and can then root you, so use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach before stepping into the area. Soraka R Wish also heals allies in other lanes, so check whether it's been used when looking for a kill.

Bard.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Bard’s damage. Being focused after the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding is more dangerous, so if you have no mobility, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance. Movement speed is also useful for getting out of announced attack areas.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, hit Bard with Senna W Last Embrace to set up a root.
Bard.escape: Right after you force Bard to use Bard E Magical Journey is an opportunity to engage. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is also down, approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, then root Bard with Senna W Last Embrace.
Bard.fight: When it’s safe, hit the same target with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. When Bard E Magical Journey is down, root him with Senna W Last Embrace and close the distance.
Bard.laning: Before moving out to collect souls, first check whether you’re positioned to get hit by Bard Q Cosmic Binding, and give up dangerous souls. If you see Bard W Caretaker’s Shrine, walk over it to remove it.
Bard.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so focus on gathering mist without dying. From mid game onward, mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, giving her more presence. Late game, use your increased range to basic attack first from a safe position.
Bard.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use your increased range to basic attack. If Bard’s side engages, use Senna W Last Embrace to stop them, and fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield range.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a line with an ally or minion. An engage can come from the side through Bard E Magical Journey, so watch your flank. Attack after the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate ends.

Blitzcrank.build: If you’re building defenses, consider magic resistance first against Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. You can prioritize tenacity if you keep dying to crowd control, but magic resistance won’t block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist.
Blitzcrank.combo: When it’s safe to poke, use Senna’s basic attack → Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off. After Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down, if there’s an opening to catch him, hit him with Senna W Last Embrace, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers.
Blitzcrank.escape: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is a chance for Senna to move forward. If Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field are also down, approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, then root the enemy with Senna W Last Embrace.
Blitzcrank.fight: Right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, poke with Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then back off immediately. Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier can activate, so don’t force an attempt to finish him just because health is low.
Blitzcrank.laning: Stand behind minions rather than beside them to block the path of Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab. Collect souls when it is safe and either the grab is down or Blitzcrank is low on mana, and give up souls in dangerous positions.
Blitzcrank.phase: Early on, Senna can die easily if caught once, so focus on keeping your distance and gathering mist. From mid game onward, mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, giving her more presence. Late game, her increased range lets her attack first from a safe position.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and attack from your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage, and use Senna R Dawning Shadow so it shields your allies. Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, so don’t move forward relying only on a shield.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, Blitzcrank can easily follow up with Blitzcrank E Power Fist and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Keep minions in front of you, and stay well away from bushes when you don’t have vision of them to avoid the grab.

Brand.build: First, build movement speed to help you get out of announced attack areas. If you need to build defense, choose magic resistance to counter Brand’s magic damage.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, slow Brand with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then use Senna W Last Embrace to target where he’ll move.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility to create distance, so go in with your allies as soon as Brand W Pillar of Flame is spent. If you’re already Ablazed, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear first, then approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist.
Brand.fight: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is used, hit with Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness in succession from a safe distance to gain mist, then back off. If Brand hasn’t Ablazed you, Brand Q Sear can’t stun you, so it’s an opportunity to close the distance with your allies.
Brand.laning: Stay away from Ablazed minions, and collect souls when Brand W Pillar of Flame is down. Give up dangerous souls, and when Brand is hard to reach directly, poke him by using Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion in front of you.
Brand.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so focus on gathering mist without dying. From mid game onward, Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, giving her more room to poke from a safe position. Late game, use your increased range to basic attack before Brand, but don’t move forward into his area attacks.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid the spread from Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm. Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and basic attack. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage. Fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the beam’s width, granting them a shield.
Brand.watch: Dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear first. If Brand’s abilities hit you in quick succession, Brand P Blaze stacks and explodes. If you’re already Ablazed when hit by Brand Q Sear, you’re stunned. If Ablazed, take cover behind minions, and spread out from allies when Brand R Pyroclasm is visible.

Caitlyn.build: Caitlyn’s damage is mostly physical and Senna has fairly low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Caitlyn.combo: If it’s hard to hit Caitlyn with Senna W Last Embrace, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap has been placed, and root Caitlyn with Senna W Last Embrace when you go in.
Caitlyn.fight: When it’s safe, hit the same target with Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Look for a poke opportunity right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.laning: Early on, survive Caitlyn’s strong laning phase without giving up kills, and gather mist. Before moving out to collect souls, watch Caitlyn’s abilities and trap locations, and give up dangerous souls. If you can’t reach Caitlyn directly, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion in front of you to poke her behind it.
Caitlyn.phase: Early on, Caitlyn’s laning phase is strong and Senna is vulnerable if caught, so focus on gathering mist without dying. From mid game onward, mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, giving her more presence. Late game, use your increased range to basic attack first from a safe position.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use your increased range to basic attack. Prioritize using Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage. When there’s an opportunity to engage with your allies, approach with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, and fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield range.
Caitlyn.watch: If Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you, Caitlyn P Headshot has increased range and deals heavy damage. Watch for traps in bushes and narrow passages, and change your approach path. When Caitlyn pokes with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind allied minions so they’re hit first.

Draven.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Draven’s physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and prioritize armor, but also consider health to survive the execute from Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.combo: Cast Senna W Last Embrace toward where Draven’s axe will land, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If there’s no angle to hit Senna W Last Embrace, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the root.
Draven.escape: When Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has one or fewer axes, close the gap with an ally. Approach together using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, then root him with Senna W Last Embrace so he can’t catch his axe again.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight while Draven has two axes. Slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness or root him with Senna W Last Embrace where an axe will land, making him miss the catch; then take short trades when he has one or fewer axes.
Draven.laning: Early on, avoid giving up kills and collect Senna P Absolution mist from a safe position. Before moving to collect souls, check Draven’s position and whether he has used his abilities; give up dangerous souls. When it’s safe, land a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately.
Draven.phase: Early on, Draven’s axe damage is strong and Senna is weak, so focus on surviving and collecting mist. From mid game, Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, creating more safe chances to poke. Late game, use the increased range to find a position where you can land a basic attack before Draven.
Draven.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Root Draven with Senna W Last Embrace when he moves in or goes to catch an axe. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that lets its shield reach allies.
Draven.watch: When Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes, his empowered basic attacks are dangerous, so avoid early trades. Watch for the slow and forced movement from Draven E Stand Aside, and get out of both the outgoing and returning paths of Draven R Whirling Death even after dodging its first hit.

Ezreal.build: The available information isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so consider both when building resistances. Movement speed to close the gap is also valuable.
Ezreal.combo: Cast Senna W Last Embrace just after Ezreal E Arcane Shift is used to set up the root. If there’s no immediate angle to hit Senna W Last Embrace, slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness first, then go for it.
Ezreal.escape: The moment after Ezreal uses Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your chance to engage. Confirm Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, then root him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Ezreal.fight: When it’s safe, land a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. After making Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift, approach with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and catch him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Ezreal.laning: Move among the minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot with them. Collect souls when Ezreal’s key abilities are down, and give up souls in dangerous positions. When poking, combine a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so avoid forced fights and collect mist. From mid game, mist increases her attack damage and range, so look more actively for safe poke angles. Late game, use your increased range to land a basic attack first, but don’t move forward and get caught.
Ezreal.teamfight: Use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally and make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift; once his mobility spell is down, root him with Senna W Last Embrace. During fights, heal allies from the back line with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that lets its shield reach allies.
Ezreal.watch: Repeatedly getting hit by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot brings Ezreal E Arcane Shift back sooner, so dodge it with minions between you. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly step out of range before his next attack. At low health, avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage by changing direction as you retreat.

Heimerdinger.build: First, get enough movement speed to walk out of the telegraphed attack areas. Heimerdinger deals magic damage, so build magic resistance rather than armor; consider tenacity too if you often get caught in the center of his grenade.
Heimerdinger.combo: After Heimerdinger’s grenade is down, hit him with Senna W Last Embrace from the side, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to hit, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then aim the root where he’ll move.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no mobility spell to escape, so go around his turret setup, close the gap, and catch him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don’t trade head-on in front of Heimerdinger’s turret setup; target Heimerdinger himself from the side.
Heimerdinger.laning: Early on, prioritize survival and collecting mist over forced trades. Before moving to collect souls, check the grenade and turret positions, and give up dangerous souls. When it’s safe, land a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately.
Heimerdinger.phase: Early on, Senna is in danger if she gets caught, so focus on surviving and collecting mist. From mid game, as her attack damage and range increase, poke Heimerdinger himself from a safe angle. Late game, use your increased range to land a basic attack first, while continuing to avoid the center of his grenades and his turret setup.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: When approaching with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, go around Heimerdinger’s turret setup. During fights, heal allies from the back line with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so damaged allies are within its shield range.
Heimerdinger.watch: If you’ve been hit, don’t stay within turret range. While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, watch out for his empowered grenade and rockets, and don’t group with allies in tight spaces.

Hwei.build: Build magic resistance first against Hwei’s magic damage. Rather than simply stacking large amounts of health, also consider movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas and tenacity against the roots from Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.combo: When Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, cast Senna W Last Embrace toward where Hwei will move. If W is hard to hit, slow him first with Q, then go for W.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility spell, so the moment Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your chance to close the gap. Approach with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and root him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Hwei.fight: From a safe distance, land a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Just after Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave, approach with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Hwei.laning: Early on, don’t risk yourself for souls; collect them when Hwei’s key abilities are down. When poking, follow a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then back off. If Hwei is out of direct range, target a minion in front with Q to hit him. Avoid paths covered by Hwei’s eyes or lava pools.
Hwei.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so avoid Hwei’s poke, stay alive, and collect mist. From mid game, mist increases her attack damage and range, letting you take safe poke opportunities more often. Late game, use your increased range to find a position where you can land a basic attack first without moving forward.
Hwei.teamfight: If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, don’t lead the engage; heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks from the back line. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, approach with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and root the opponent with Senna W Last Embrace. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within its shield range.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up attacks too. If one of Hwei’s abilities hits you, move immediately to avoid his second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also watch out for the percent max health damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster and the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair.

Janna.combo: For a safe trade, land Senna Q Piercing Darkness after Senna’s basic attack to gain mist, then back off. After Janna Q Howling Gale is down, if you hit with Senna W Last Embrace, follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to hit immediately, apply a slow first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the root.
Janna.escape: The window to approach is when Janna Q Howling Gale misses and Janna E Eye Of The Storm is down. If she has also used Janna R Monsoon, the risk of being pushed back is lower, so approach with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Janna.fight: From a safe distance, land one basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Senna P Absolution mist, then back off immediately. Look to apply the root with Senna W Last Embrace when Janna E Eye Of The Storm is down or Janna Q Howling Gale misses. When approaching, move with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist.
Janna.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting mist, and check the position of Janna Q Howling Gale before moving to collect souls. Poke an ally protected by Janna to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then deal damage again after the shield is gone. You can also target a minion in front of the enemy with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to hit that enemy behind it.
Janna.phase: Early on, Senna is in danger if caught, so dodge Janna’s poke while collecting Senna P Absolution mist. In particular, avoid trading when Janna E Eye Of The Storm is active, as the enemy’s counterattack is stronger. From mid game, Senna’s attack damage and range increase; late game, use your increased range to land a basic attack first from a safe position.
Janna.teamfight: Heal allies from the back line with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks with your increased range. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root an enemy who engages, or to catch Janna when she’s separated from her allies. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within its shield range, and watch out for approaches that could get pushed back while Janna R Monsoon is available.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks you up, so if you hear it from a bush or out of vision, move out of its path. Janna W Zephyr’s slow makes it harder to retreat, and Janna R Monsoon can push away approaching allies and disengage the fight. Don’t dump all your damage at once onto a target protected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm.

Jhin.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin’s damage is mostly physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first.
Jhin.combo: If Jhin is reloading and you have an angle to hit Senna W Last Embrace, set up the root first, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when it triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to hit, slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness first, then go for Senna W Last Embrace.
Jhin.escape: When closing the gap on Jhin, look for his reload or the window when Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down. Jhin has no ability to create distance, so once you’re close, root him with Senna W Last Embrace. Don’t engage while Jhin has his last bullet or along a straight path where Jhin W Deadly Flourish can hit you.
Jhin.fight: When Jhin is reloading or has fired one or two shots, land Senna’s basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Avoid trading while Jhin has his last bullet. After Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down, if you close the gap, look to root him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Jhin.laning: Stand a short distance from low-health minions so Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can’t bounce off a kill and hit you with increased damage. Check Jhin’s bullets and whether he has used Jhin W Deadly Flourish before collecting souls; take them only when safe and give up souls in dangerous positions. Don’t take your allied marksman’s last hits.
Jhin.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so getting caught by Jhin’s last bullet and root is dangerous; focus on surviving and collecting mist. From mid game, as mist increases your attack damage and range, poke from safe angles more often. Late game, use your increased range to find a position where you can land a basic attack before Jhin.
Jhin.teamfight: Heal allies from the back line with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Use Senna W Last Embrace to stop enemies who engage. When approaching with an ally, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, and cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within its shield range. If you need to block Jhin R Curtain Call, have the ally with the highest health percentage take the bullet.
Jhin.watch: The last bullet of Jhin P Whisper deals heavy damage, so count his remaining bullets and back off when he has one left. Immediately after being hit by Jhin’s basic attack or stepping on Jhin E Captive Audience, watch out for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. At low health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Jinx.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to withstand the early game. Jinx mainly deals physical damage and Senna has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Jinx.combo: After Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down, hit Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions to set up the root. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to hit, apply the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness first, then go for Senna W Last Embrace.
Jinx.escape: The window to close the gap is when Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used. Also look to engage as soon as the slow from Jinx W Zap! misses. Once you’re close, root Jinx with Senna W Last Embrace.
Jinx.fight: When it’s safe, land one basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. When Jinx pokes with rockets, it’s an opportunity when she has no minigun attack speed stacks, but Senna is fragile early on, so check whether Jinx E Flame Chompers! has been used before closing the gap.
Jinx.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting mist. Check Jinx’s abilities and position before moving to collect souls, and give up dangerous souls. If Jinx is hard to reach directly, target a minion in front of her with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to poke her behind it, but don’t take your allied marksman’s last hits.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Senna is fragile, so prioritize survival and collecting mist over forced fights. From mid game, as mist increases your attack damage and range, poke from a safe distance. Late game, use your increased range to find a position where you can land a basic attack before Jinx.
Jinx.teamfight: Use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to create an opportunity to approach with an ally, but don’t stay forward for long. Heal allies from the back line with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Use Senna W Last Embrace when Jinx tries to stop an ally from engaging or to follow up on your ally’s engage. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow to shield allies instead of only trying to finish off Jinx.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets also deal damage around minions, so don’t stand on top of them. Dodge the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and if health has been reduced, don’t stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!, whose damage increases with missing health. Right after an ally dies or a turret is destroyed, Jinx P Get Excited! grants movement and attack speed, so don’t start a fight.

Kaisa.build: Withstand the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker deal magic damage that armor can’t block, so if you can’t burst her down, build magic resistance and health too.
Kaisa.combo: During the window when Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, hit her with Senna W Last Embrace, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to hit, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then go for Senna W Last Embrace. When engaging together in a team fight, approach with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, apply the root with Senna W Last Embrace, then shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Kaisa.escape: Hit Kai'Sa with Senna W Last Embrace here to root her and pressure her with your ally.
Kaisa.fight: When it’s safe, land Senna’s basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Fight after Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, rooting her with Senna W Last Embrace. When engaging with an ally, approach using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist.
Kaisa.laning: Senna is also in danger if caught early, so check Kai'Sa’s ability usage and the soul’s position when collecting souls. When Kai'Sa looks likely to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, don’t separate from allied minions.
Kaisa.phase: In mid game, mist collected with Senna P Absolution increases your attack damage and range, so make use of the benefits earned by surviving and gathering mist. Late game, use your increased range to land a basic attack first, but don’t move forward and get picked off.
Kaisa.teamfight: Heal allies from the back line with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. If Kai'Sa jumps in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, root her with Senna W Last Embrace to stop the engage. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within its shield range.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears, denying Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct an angle to engage. When taking hits from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stand near allied minions so the missiles spread out. If you’re low on health and stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin have built up, wait out of range for the stacks to fall off.

Kalista.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Since Kalista’s main damage is physical and Senna has relatively low armor, build armor first.
Kalista.combo: Throw Senna W Last Embrace just as Kalista starts a basic attack, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If it’s hard to land Senna W Last Embrace, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the root.
Kalista.escape: While Kalista R Fate's Call is down, look for a chance to catch Kalista with Senna W Last Embrace.
Kalista.fight: From a safe angle, land one basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Senna P Absolution mist, then back away immediately. If you hit Senna W Last Embrace just as Kalista starts a basic attack, follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers.
Kalista.laning: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so focus on collecting Senna P Absolution mist without dying. Check Kalista’s position and abilities before moving out to collect souls, and leave souls in dangerous spots. If spears have stacked on you or Kalista starts basic attacking you, retreat behind a bush or wall to break vision.
Kalista.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so prioritize avoiding Kalista’s engage. In the mid game, Senna P Absolution increases your attack damage and range, giving you more chances to poke. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Kalista.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks with your increased range. If Kalista R Fate's Call looks like it will bring her support in, spread out and prepare Senna W Last Embrace at the expected landing spot. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s area.
Kalista.watch: Kalista P Martial Poise leads into a leap when she starts a basic attack, so predict when the leap will begin and aim Senna W Last Embrace. If she has several spears stuck in you, Kalista E Rend can deal dangerous damage, so stop fighting and back away until the spears disappear. If Kalista’s support stays close to her, spread out to prepare for Kalista R Fate's Call.

Karma.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Karma’s main damage. Also get movement speed so you can leave the range of Karma Q Inner Flame and break Karma W Focused Resolve’s tether.
Karma.combo: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, aim Senna W Last Embrace at the spot Karma is moving toward. If Senna W Last Embrace misses, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the next Senna W Last Embrace.
Karma.escape: When Karma W Focused Resolve is down, that’s your chance to engage. If a shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E is active, wait for it to expire before going in. If Karma W Focused Resolve is tethered to you, stop the engage and create distance before it roots you.
Karma.fight: Keep your distance while Karma W Focused Resolve is ready. From a safe angle, land a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness in quick succession to collect mist, then back away immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve is down, look for a root with Senna W Last Embrace.
Karma.laning: Early on, focus on collecting Senna P Absolution mist without dying. Before moving out to collect souls, check whether Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve are down. To poke Karma when she’s hard to reach directly, cast Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion in front of you.
Karma.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so collect mist while avoiding Karma’s poke and root. In the mid game, Senna P Absolution increases your attack damage and range, making you more impactful. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Karma.teamfight: Use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your allies, but don’t rush in while Karma W Focused Resolve is ready. After Karma R Mantra-empowered E’s shield ends, use Senna W Last Embrace to catch the enemy team. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s area, and heal them with Senna Q Piercing Darkness from the backline while adding basic attacks.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame slows and deals area damage, so stand behind minions or outside its range. If you’re hit by the field from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, immediately walk out of the area before it detonates. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance before it roots you; also account for Karma healing if it’s empowered by Karma R Mantra.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first, considering the magic damage from Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. You also need armor against his physical basic attack damage, but don’t rely on stacking health alone because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.combo: Once Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, cast Senna W Last Embrace from a gap between minions or from the side toward where Kog'Maw will move. If it’s hard to land, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the root.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility ability to create distance, so look to approach after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends and you’ve avoided the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and catch Kog'Maw with Senna W Last Embrace.
KogMaw.fight: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends, land basic attacks with Senna’s increased range. From a safe angle, combine a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect mist, then back away immediately. Kog'Maw has no mobility ability to create distance, so catch him with Senna W Last Embrace when your allies approach.
KogMaw.laning: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so collect souls without dying. Before moving out to collect them, check how long Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage lasts and watch for Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, and leave souls in dangerous spots. Let your ally last-hit minions, but poke Kog'Maw with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness from a safe angle to collect mist.
KogMaw.phase: Senna is weak early, so prioritize surviving and collecting mist over forcing fights. In the mid game, use Senna’s increased attack damage and range from mist to take advantage of the windows after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage ends. Senna’s range is strong in the late game, but Kog'Maw also gets stronger over time, so disrupt his farming and secure objectives and turrets from the early and mid game onward.
KogMaw.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and attack Kog'Maw with your increased range. Catch him with Senna W Last Embrace when an ally engages on him; if you need to stop an enemy engage, save the root for when that enemy comes in. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that can hit Kog'Maw and shield your allies.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, his range and basic attack damage increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces your armor and magic resistance if it hits, so dodge from behind minions and keep your distance for a while if you’re hit.

Leona.build: Senna’s physical damage is blocked by Leona’s high armor, so build some penetration. If Leona catches and kills you, consider tenacity before magic resistance; choose resistance based on the damage type of the enemy carry dealing damage while you’re caught.
Leona.combo: From a safe angle, land a basic attack and then Senna Q Piercing Darkness on the same target before backing away. When Leona E Zenith Blade is down, look for a chance to counterattack with Senna W Last Embrace, then follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land right away, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try for the root.
Leona.escape: Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down, Senna has a window to close the distance. Stay out of range where Leona Q Shield of Daybreak or Leona R Solar Flare could catch you again, and use Senna W Last Embrace to root her when the opportunity comes.
Leona.fight: While Leona E Zenith Blade is ready, land one Senna basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness from a safe distance to collect mist, then back away immediately. If Leona E Zenith Blade is down, counterattack with the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness or the root from Senna W Last Embrace.
Leona.laning: Early on, account for Leona’s high armor and Senna’s low health by focusing on collecting mist without dying. Check whether Leona E Zenith Blade is down before moving out to collect souls, and leave souls in dangerous spots. You can use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion to poke an enemy behind it.
Leona.phase: Early on, Leona has high armor and Senna is vulnerable if caught, so be especially wary of Leona’s engage. From the mid game onward, Senna’s increased attack damage and range from mist give you more room to poke. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Leona.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to respond to Leona’s engage, and back away to avoid follow-up attacks if you’re marked by Sunlight. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s area.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and dashes her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in line with your allies. Leona can activate Leona Q Shield of Daybreak before approaching, so dodge based on her distance rather than waiting to see whether she casts it. When Leona R Solar Flare’s indicator appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center. When Leona W Eclipse is active, leave its range before it explodes.

Lucian.build: Lucian’s main damage is physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first. Early on, buy Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Lucian.combo: After Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, cast Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try for W.
Lucian.escape: Right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is used, you have a window to close the distance. If his first combo is also down, catch him with Senna W Last Embrace and counterattack.
Lucian.fight: Early on, let Lucian’s first combo pass, then briefly counterattack after his abilities are down. From a safe distance, land a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness in quick succession to collect mist, then back away immediately. If Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, look for a chance to catch him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Lucian.laning: Collect Senna P Absolution souls when Lucian’s key abilities are down and your position is safe. Don’t move too far forward or approach the enemy turret just to collect a soul. Avoid the line of Lucian Q Piercing Light, and use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion in front of you to reach an enemy you can’t hit directly.
Lucian.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so survive Lucian’s burst and collect mist. In the mid game, use Senna P Absolution’s increased attack damage and range to poke from a safe distance. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack, but don’t move forward and get caught.
Lucian.teamfight: You can use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your allies. During a fight, heal them with Senna Q Piercing Darkness from the backline and add basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace in case Lucian engages. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that reaches your allies with its shield.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light pierces minions and reaches farther than its displayed range, so step out of the line behind minions when Lucian farms with Q. Watch for his first combo, where he dashes in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit and follows with Lucian P Lightslinger. Avoid trading right after the enemy support protects or heals Lucian. When he uses Lucian R The Culling, move sideways instead of running straight back.

Lulu.build: For your starting purchase, prioritize movement speed to leave telegraphed areas over durability against Lulu’s slow. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Lulu’s own damage. However, choose resistance based on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting, and consider tenacity against Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.combo: When poking, land a basic attack and then Senna Q Piercing Darkness on the same target to collect mist before backing away. After Lulu W Whimsy is down, approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, then cast Senna W Last Embrace from a gap between minions toward Lulu’s direction of movement.
Lulu.escape: After Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally, you have a window to approach. If Lulu R Wild Growth is also down, close the distance with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and root Lulu with Senna W Last Embrace. Don’t go in first while Lulu’s crowd control is ready, since Senna has no separate escape ability.
Lulu.fight: Lulu is good at stopping hard engages, so poke briefly with Senna basic attacks and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect mist. When Lulu E Help, Pix! is shielding her allied carry and Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally, that’s a chance to target Lulu herself. Approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and root Lulu with Senna W Last Embrace.
Lulu.laning: Early on, focus on collecting mist without dying. Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and from a safe angle, land Senna Q Piercing Darkness after a basic attack, then back away immediately. Collect souls when Lulu’s key abilities are down, and leave dangerous souls near the enemy turret.
Lulu.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so collect mist safely because getting caught is dangerous. In the mid game, your increased attack damage and range from mist make Lulu a good target for brief pokes. In the late game, use your increased range to land basic attacks first, but don’t move into range of Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth while they’re ready.
Lulu.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop an enemy engage or use it with an ally’s engage, and don’t focus only on the protected target while Lulu R Wild Growth is ready. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the beam’s width and shield them.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy silences you and prevents you from attacking, so don’t move close while it’s ready. If Lulu Q Glitterlance’s slow is followed by Lulu R Wild Growth’s knock-up, Senna is in danger with no ability to escape. If Lulu R Wild Growth is ready, don’t try to immediately catch the target she’s protecting.

Lux.build: Build magic resistance before armor to counter Lux’s main damage. Also get movement speed so you can leave the area telegraphed by Lux E Lucent Singularity. Get tenacity along with magic resistance in case Lux Q Light Binding roots you and she follows up with more abilities.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, slow her with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and look for Senna W Last Embrace. If Senna W Last Embrace hits, follow up with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. In lane, cast Senna W Last Embrace from a gap or the side so minions don’t block it.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses, you have a chance to close the distance. Lux has no mobility ability, so approach from the side and land Senna W Last Embrace to make it hard for her to escape. Avoid the area marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity as you approach.
Lux.fight: Bait out and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then land a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness in quick succession from a safe distance to collect mist before backing away. Lux has no mobility ability, so look for a root with Senna W Last Embrace when you get a chance to close the distance. Senna’s physical damage is effective against Lux’s low armor.
Lux.laning: Early on, watch out for Lux Q Light Binding and collect mist without dying. Before moving out for souls, check whether Lux’s key abilities are down, and leave souls in dangerous spots. If there’s no direct angle to poke her, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion in front of you to reach Lux behind it.
Lux.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so collect mist while being especially careful not to get caught by Lux Q Light Binding. In the mid game, your increased attack damage and range from mist let you take safe poke angles more often. In the late game, use your increased range to find a position where you can land a basic attack before Lux, while continuing to dodge Lux Q Light Binding.
Lux.teamfight: Don’t group together with your allies when approaching, so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch all of you at once. From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range; use Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s area.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, more abilities follow, so don’t stand in line with your allies and dodge when Q comes toward you. Leave the area marked by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and move sideways when you see the aim line for Lux R Final Spark. If Lux’s ability hits you and applies Illumination, get outside her basic attack range.

MissFortune.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive early, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Miss Fortune's main damage is physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first.
MissFortune.combo: Land Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace misses, apply Senna Q Piercing Darkness's slow first and look for another root.
MissFortune.escape: Approach when Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down and you've left its area. Miss Fortune has no mobility ability, so close the gap and root her with Senna W Last Embrace. If she runs, deal damage once to reset the movement speed from Miss Fortune W Strut.
MissFortune.fight: From a safe distance, hit the same target with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then immediately back away. Don't start a fight where Miss Fortune E Make It Rain has been placed.
MissFortune.laning: Take a position to the side, out of line with the minions, to avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. Back away right after Miss Fortune last-hits a minion. Collect souls when the enemy's key abilities are down and it's safe; give up souls in dangerous positions.
MissFortune.phase: Senna has low health and attack damage early, so focus on staying alive and collecting Mist. From mid game onward, poke with your accumulated attack damage and range; in late game, land the first basic attack from a safe position using your increased range.
MissFortune.teamfight: Delay your engage while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is placed, and look for a chance to interrupt Miss Fortune R Bullet Time with Senna W Last Embrace's root. Even when using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with allies, stay in the backline and heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the shield's range.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces backward after hitting its first target, so don't stand directly behind a minion. Move out of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain when it's placed, and when Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move beside the cone or interrupt it with Senna W Last Embrace's root.

Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana's magic damage. Senna has no ability to escape on her own and is vulnerable to roots and stuns, so consider tenacity first if you're often caught and killed. If Morgana's healing becomes a problem in extended fights, consider Grievous Wounds after that.
Morgana.combo: After Morgana E Black Shield is down, fire Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side. Combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is difficult to hit, slow first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then go for it.
Morgana.escape: When Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down, look for a chance to approach. Morgana has no ability to create distance herself, so use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your allies and catch her with Senna W Last Embrace.
Morgana.fight: From a position where you can dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, make a short trade with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then back away. Senna's physical damage is effective against Morgana's low armor. Don't use Senna W Last Embrace on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Keep minions between you and Morgana to block Morgana Q Dark Binding. After a basic attack, hit her with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then immediately back away. Before moving up to collect a soul, check whether Morgana can use Morgana Q Dark Binding, and give up souls in dangerous positions. To poke an opponent you can't reach directly, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on the minion in front.
Morgana.phase: Senna has low health and attack damage early, so getting caught once is dangerous; focus on staying alive and collecting Mist. From mid game onward, the increased attack damage and range from Mist give you more room to poke from a safe position. In late game, land the first basic attack with your increased range while staying positioned to avoid Morgana Q Dark Binding.
Morgana.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks from your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop an enemy from engaging, but don't use it on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield. Fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the shield's range, and move with your allies when engaging with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist.
Morgana.watch: If Morgana Q Dark Binding hits you, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks can easily land, so move with minions between you and her. When low on health, don't walk through Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles connects to you, get out of range before the stun triggers.

Nami.build: Consider Executioner's Calling first to reduce the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Nami's ability damage.
Nami.combo: If Senna W Last Embrace hits Nami, combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to hit, slow first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then fire Senna W Last Embrace where Nami is going.
Nami.escape: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to go in on Nami. Dodge Nami R Tidal Wave, then close the gap to Nami and catch her with Senna W Last Embrace.
Nami.fight: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, target Nami with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then back away. Don't fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; wait for the effect to end, then look for an opening again.
Nami.laning: Focus on collecting Mist without getting caught early, and check whether Nami can use Nami Q Aqua Prison before moving up for a soul. Look for vision and poke angles on Nami's side, but give up souls in dangerous positions and avoid taking minion last hits from your allied marksman.
Nami.phase: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so stay alive, collect Mist, and only take short pokes when Nami Q Aqua Prison misses. From mid game onward, use the increased attack damage and range from Mist; in late game, attack from a safe position using your range advantage.
Nami.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks from your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace for situations where enemies follow up after Nami's crowd control, and fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the shield's range.
Nami.watch: If Nami Q Aqua Prison hits you, you're likely to take follow-up attacks while stunned, so sidestep when you see its landing indicator. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as you see it, and don't fight a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing until its duration ends.

Nautilus.build: Nautilus's high armor can block much of Senna's physical damage, so include armor penetration. Build magic resistance first against Nautilus's main damage, but if crowd control is catching and killing you, you can prioritize tenacity instead.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, root him with Senna W Last Embrace, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If there's no angle to hit Senna W Last Embrace, slow first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then go for it.
Nautilus.escape: If you make Nautilus use Nautilus Q Dredge Line and then create distance, it's hard for him to catch up. During a window when Nautilus Q Dredge Line and his crowd control are down, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with your allies and look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is a chance to trade safely. Slow with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add a basic attack, but back away before Nautilus P Staggering Blow's basic attack can reach you.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and from a safe angle hit the same target with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist. Before moving up to collect a soul, check whether Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, and give up souls in dangerous positions.
Nautilus.phase: Senna is in danger if caught once early, so avoid Nautilus's engage and collect Mist. From mid game onward, Mist increases your attack damage and range; in late game, land the first basic attack from your increased range.
Nautilus.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks from your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop Nautilus's engage, and don't stand in line with your allies along Nautilus R Depth Charge's path. Fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the shield's range.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line leads into an engage and stun, so dodge it with minions between you and him. Nautilus P Staggering Blow also roots with his first basic attack, so don't stay within his attack range. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don't stand in line with your allies along its path.

Neeko.build: Build magic resistance first against Neeko's main damage. Prioritize tenacity if Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom follows. Movement speed to dodge a telegraphed area attack is also valuable.
Neeko.combo: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, slow with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for Senna W Last Embrace. If Senna W Last Embrace hits, combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. Fire it through a gap or from the side so minions don't block Senna W Last Embrace.
Neeko.escape: The window while Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and Neeko R Pop Blossom are down is your chance to move forward. Root Neeko with Senna W Last Embrace then and try to trade.
Neeko.fight: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, poke from Senna's range with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Neeko has low armor, so Senna's physical damage is effective, but Senna has no ability to escape if caught, so keep your distance first. While Neeko R Pop Blossom is down, look for a root with Senna W Last Embrace.
Neeko.laning: Focus on staying alive and collecting Mist early, but check whether Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down before collecting a soul. From a safe angle, hit the same Neeko twice with a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then immediately back away. You can also poke Neeko behind the front minion by using Senna Q Piercing Darkness on it.
Neeko.phase: Senna is weak early, so collect Mist without getting caught by Neeko. From mid game onward, Senna's attack damage and range increase; in late game, land the first basic attack from a safe position using your increased range.
Neeko.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs doesn't root several of you at once. If Neeko engages, stop her with Senna W Last Embrace, and leave the area when you see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom. Heal allies from the backline with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and shield them with Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up when it hits the first target, so don't stand in a line behind minions or allies. If an opponent disguised using Neeko P Inherent Glamour approaches, you might not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so create distance in advance. Don't chase the Neeko W Shapesplitter clone.

Nilah.build: Nilah's main damage is physical and Senna has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots, and build both armor and health to account for Nilah Q Formless Blade's penetration. If healing makes duels go long, consider Grievous Wounds after you have resistances.
Nilah.combo: After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, land a Senna basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then back away. If Nilah engages and uses W, queue up Senna W Last Embrace to root her, then combine Q and a basic attack as the root triggers. If there's no angle to hit Senna W, slow first with Q and look for W.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don't go deep just because it is down. Go in when Nilah has engaged, used Nilah W Jubilant Veil, and you can catch her with Senna W Last Embrace. If Nilah R Apotheosis is still available, keep your distance from allies.
Nilah.fight: Poke briefly with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness from a distance where Nilah can't close in, then back away immediately. Stop using basic attacks while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, and trade again after it ends. If Nilah engages and uses W, look for a chance to catch her with Senna W Last Embrace.
Nilah.laning: When moving up to collect a soul, check Nilah's position and whether she has used her abilities; give up dangerous souls. Collect Mist through safe poke while avoiding your allied marksman's minion last hits.
Nilah.phase: In mid game, use the increased attack damage and range from Mist to poke from a safe position. In late game, land the first basic attack before Nilah with your increased range, while continuing to deny her engage angles.
Nilah.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks from your increased range. Spread out so Nilah R Apotheosis doesn't catch several allies at once, and root Nilah with Senna W Last Embrace when she engages. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so its shield reaches allies taking damage from Nilah.
Nilah.watch: After Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range and attack area increase, so take another step back. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, your basic attacks miss, so wait until its duration ends. Watch for Nilah E Slipstream to close the gap, and don't bunch up with allies while Nilah R Apotheosis is available.

Pantheon.build: Start with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pantheon's main damage is physical, so build armor first. Pantheon has relatively high armor, so include penetration when increasing your damage.
Pantheon.combo: When Pantheon engages, queue up Senna W Last Embrace to root him, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If there's no angle to hit Senna W Last Embrace, slow first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for Senna W Last Embrace. Don't rush your damage while Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking from the front.
Pantheon.escape: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and the risk of being stunned is lower, look for a chance to move forward. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall won't be available again yet, root him with Senna W Last Embrace and engage with your allies. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, keep your distance while accounting for his remaining mobility.
Pantheon.fight: Avoid trading damage head-on early and wait for a safe poke angle outside Pantheon W Shield Vault range. When you find an opening, hit the same target with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain Mist, then back away immediately. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait until his frontal defense ends before attacking, or take an angle from the side.
Pantheon.laning: When moving up to collect a soul, check positioning and Pantheon W Shield Vault's range together. Collect souls when Pantheon's key abilities are down, and give up souls in dangerous positions. Keep minions between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke, and avoid taking minion last hits from your allied marksman.
Pantheon.phase: In mid game, Senna's attack damage and range increase, so increase your poke from a safe distance. In late game, Pantheon's influence falls while Senna's range advantage grows, so land the first basic attack from that range.
Pantheon.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks from your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to catch Pantheon when he engages. When approaching with allies, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, and fire Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the shield's range.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns you, so don't give him its range. When Pantheon Q Comet Spear is used for poke, keep minions between you and him. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area.

Pyke.build: Build Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Pyke deals mostly physical damage, and Senna has low armor, so build armor first. Also consider your total health, since Pyke builds lethality and uses R to execute low-health targets.
Pyke.combo: For a safe trade, land a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off. Once Pyke’s engage is down, set up a root with Senna W Last Embrace and overlap Q and a basic attack when the root triggers. If W misses, apply Q’s slow first, then try W again.
