Pyke.escape: Even if you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow, don’t rush in while Pyke R Death From Below is still available. In particular, before R comes back up, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally during the window when E is also down, then land Senna W Last Embrace.
Pyke.fight: Hit the same Pyke with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then immediately create distance. Dodge the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, then look for a chance to root the remaining Pyke with Senna W Last Embrace. Look to engage when Pyke R Death From Below is also down.
Pyke.laning: Focus on staying alive and gathering mist early. Check your position and Pyke’s abilities when collecting souls, and give up souls in dangerous spots. When Pyke backs away, maintain vision to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so getting caught by Pyke is dangerous; prioritize keeping your distance and gathering mist. From mid game, mist increases her attack damage and range, making her more impactful. In late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Pyke.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop Pyke’s engage, and cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s range. When Pyke R Death From Below threatens a low-health ally, don’t stand beside them.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls Senna in or Pyke E Phantom Undertow stuns her, Senna has no escape and is easy to hit again. When health has decreased, watch out for Pyke R Death From Below as well.

Rakan.build: Rakan’s threat starts with the crowd control from Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness, so get a way to remove crowd control first. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance to counter Rakan’s damage.
Rakan.combo: After Rakan W Grand Entrance is down, land Senna W Last Embrace, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land immediately, slow Rakan first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then cast Senna W Last Embrace where he’s heading.
Rakan.escape: Move forward after Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan R The Quickness are down. In particular, right after dodging Rakan W Grand Entrance, look for a chance to root him with Senna W Last Embrace and follow with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade right after Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield breaks. From a safe distance, hit the same target with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. If Rakan W Grand Entrance is down, look for a chance to root him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Rakan.laning: Early on, keep your distance to avoid Rakan W Grand Entrance and gather mist. Before going for a soul, check whether Rakan W Grand Entrance is down, and give up souls in dangerous spots. You can use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion to harass Rakan behind it.
Rakan.phase: Early on, Senna is weak and can be hit repeatedly if Rakan engages on her, so prioritize survival and gathering mist. From mid game, Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, giving her more opportunities to harass. In late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Rakan.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace to respond to Rakan’s engage, and use it with Rakan W Grand Entrance’s landing point in mind. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s range.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance knocks up at its landing point, so move to the side when Rakan starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, it's hard to escape on foot, so keep terrain between you and Rakan and don't stand in a line with allies.

Rell.build: The provided information doesn't specify an item to buy first, so a purchase order can't be determined. Consider magic resistance rather than armor against Rell's damage. Since Senna has no mobility, consider tenacity first if crowd control is getting you killed.
Rell.combo: When Rell E Full Tilt is down, land Senna W Last Embrace to set up a root, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when it triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, slow Rell first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try W.
Rell.escape: Don’t go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; wait until Rell E Full Tilt is down too. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root Rell during that window. If Rell Q Shattering Strike has also been used, you can add the shield from Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Rell.fight: From outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range, land one Senna basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Create distance right after Rell uses Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, and look to root her with Senna W Last Embrace during a window when Rell E Full Tilt is also down.
Rell.laning: Early on, stay alive and collect Senna P Absolution mist, but check Rell’s engage range and whether she has used her key abilities before picking up souls. From a safe angle, land a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then immediately back away. Give up souls in dangerous spots, and don’t take your allies’ minion last hits.
Rell.phase: Early on, getting caught is dangerous for Senna, so watch for Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and focus on survival and gathering mist. From mid game, Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, making her more impactful. In late game, use your increased range to attack first from outside Rell’s engage range.
Rell.teamfight: Spread out from allies before engaging so several of you aren't pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm. From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness while attacking. Save Senna W Last Embrace to respond to Rell's engage, and cast the shield from Senna R Dawning Shadow after Rell Q Shattering Strike has passed, positioning so allies are within the beam's width.
Rell.watch: If Rell E Full Tilt suddenly speeds up Rell and one ally, treat it as an engage signal: stop trading and move out of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down’s range. If Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down knocks you up, you’re easy to catch again. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so dodge it to the side and use your shield afterward.

Renata.build: First get a way to remove crowd control, such as Quicksilver Sash, to prepare for the crowd control from Renata Glasc Q Handshake and R Hostile Takeover. If you need resistance against her damage, build magic resistance over armor.
Renata.combo: After Renata Glasc’s crowd control is down, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally, then land Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side. Overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If W is hard to land, apply Q’s slow first, then try W.
Renata.escape: The window to approach opens after Renata Glasc Q Handshake and R Hostile Takeover are down. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so once you’ve closed the distance with an ally, block her escape with Senna W Last Embrace.
Renata.fight: From a safe distance, hit the same target with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. After dodging Renata Glasc Q Handshake and R Hostile Takeover, or after she has used them, close in with an ally and root Renata Glasc, who has no mobility ability, with Senna W Last Embrace.
Renata.laning: Early on, focus on staying alive and gathering mist. Before picking up a soul, check where Renata Glasc Q Handshake and E Loyalty Program can reach. When going for a soul or harass, use a window when the enemy’s key abilities are down. If it’s hard to hit her directly, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on the front minion to hit Renata Glasc behind it, then pair it with a basic attack to gain mist.
Renata.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so getting caught is dangerous; prioritize survival and gathering mist. Renata Glasc also has low health and attack damage early and no mobility ability, so pressure her only when her key abilities are down. From mid game, mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range; in late game, land basic attacks safely from your increased range.
Renata.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, and don’t approach in a line when using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to move in. From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the beam’s width and receive the shield.
Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, you’re rooted, and after you’re thrown, allies can be stunned too, so dodge from behind a minion or your front line. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies so you aren’t hit together. Immediately after taking down an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, back off so they can’t fully revive through a takedown.

Samira.build: Build Cloth Armor first early on. Samira deals mostly physical damage, and Senna has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Samira.combo: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends, land Senna W Last Embrace, then overlap Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack when the root triggers. If there’s no angle to land Senna W Last Embrace, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try W.
Samira.escape: The moment after Samira E Wild Rush is down is a window to close the distance. If the enemy’s crowd control is also down, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally, then land Senna W Last Embrace after Samira W Blade Whirl ends.
Samira.fight: When Samira walks in, use your range advantage to land one Senna basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. If Samira has used Samira E Wild Rush and nobody has died, wait for Samira W Blade Whirl to end, then look for a chance to root her with Senna W Last Embrace and secure the takedown.
Samira.laning: Early on, stay alive and gather mist, while watching Samira’s engage angle and whether she has used her key abilities when you go for souls. Avoid taking your allied marksman’s last hits. From a safe angle, harass with a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist. Trade briefly and back off so Samira can’t get close and build style.
Samira.phase: Early on, getting caught is dangerous for Senna, so focus on survival and gathering mist. From mid game, once mist increases her attack damage and range, use your range advantage to harass. In late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Samira.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace to stop Samira’s engage or interrupt Samira R Inferno Trigger. If nobody died after Samira engaged, root her then and secure the takedown. Shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow when your team is losing a fight.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles, so use Senna W Last Embrace and basic attacks after the spin ends. If the enemy support’s crowd control hits you, Samira P Daredevil Impulse can let her dash in, so dodge their engage ability first. If Samira has built style, create distance to prepare for Samira R Inferno Trigger; once it starts, interrupt it with the root from Senna W Last Embrace.

Seraphine.build: Prioritize magic resistance to withstand Seraphine’s main damage. The provided information doesn’t specify a first purchase, so none can be named.
Seraphine.combo: After Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, cast Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try W.
Seraphine.escape: Look to engage on Seraphine right after Seraphine E Beat Drop misses or is used. If Seraphine R Encore is also down, the risk of getting caught is lower. You can use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally.
Seraphine.fight: Right after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is a chance to close the distance. When Seraphine is alone and separated from an allied marksman, hit her with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. While Seraphine E Beat Drop is ready, keep your distance because Senna is easy to hit again if caught once.
Seraphine.laning: Early on, focus on staying alive and gathering mist. Before going for a soul, check whether Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, and give up souls in dangerous spots. You can use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on the front minion to hit Seraphine behind it.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, it’s important for Senna to avoid getting caught by Seraphine, since her health and attack damage are low. From mid game, as mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, she gets more chances to harass safely. In late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from the back line.
Seraphine.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage, and spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore doesn’t extend through your allies. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s range.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, first move out of the straight path in front of Seraphine. In team fights, Seraphine R Encore reaches farther each time it passes through an allied champion, so don’t stand in a line with your allies.

Sivir.build: Sivir’s main damage is physical, and Senna has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Sivir.combo: Feint an approach to bait out Sivir E Spell Shield, then cast Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, wait for the shield to be down, slow her with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try for the root.
Sivir.escape: If Sivir R On The Hunt is active, avoid a long chase and close the distance again after its effect ends.
Sivir.fight: From a safe range, land one Senna basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Once Sivir E Spell Shield is down, continue the trade with the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness or the root from Senna W Last Embrace.
Sivir.laning: Early on, stay alive and gather mist, while watching the path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade when going for souls. Pick up souls when it’s safe after Sivir uses a key ability, and avoid taking your allied marksman’s minion last hits. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push the lane first or arrange for another ally to catch it before leaving lane.
Sivir.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so prioritize survival and gathering mist over risky trades. From mid game, once mist increases her attack damage and range, take more safe harass opportunities. In late game, use your increased range to find a position where you can land a basic attack before Sivir.
Sivir.teamfight: Use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally, then heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks from the back line once the fight starts. Use Senna W Last Embrace to stop an engaging enemy or catch Sivir once Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the beam’s width and receive the shield.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and on the way back, so even if the first hit lands, move out of its return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so check that it’s down before using Senna W Last Embrace. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the whole enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Smolder.build: Build Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Smolder deals mostly physical damage, and Senna has low armor, so build armor first. However, armor alone can’t counter the true damage and execute from a grown Smolder’s Q Super Scorcher Breath.
Smolder.combo: When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, aim Senna W Last Embrace where he’ll move to set up a root. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, apply the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness first, then try W.
Smolder.escape: The moment after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down is a chance to engage. Root him with Senna W Last Embrace and close the distance with an ally. Don’t recklessly chase while slowed by Smolder W Achooo!.
Smolder.fight: From a safe distance, hit the same target with a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. After baiting out Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap, root him with Senna W Last Embrace and pressure him. If Senna goes too far forward first, she can be taken down easily, so keep your distance.
Smolder.laning: Dodge harass and disrupt Smolder’s farming so he can’t grow by hitting abilities or killing enemies with Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath. Senna is easy to catch early, so check enemy abilities and positions when collecting souls, and give up dangerous souls. From a safe angle, harass with Senna basic attacks and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gather mist.
Smolder.phase: Both are weak early, but you have a chance to pressure Smolder before he stacks growth. In mid game, use Senna’s range and attack damage from mist to take objectives and turrets quickly. The longer the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Smolder, so in late game Senna should fight from a safe distance.
Smolder.teamfight: When using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally, look for a window when Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down. Use Senna W Last Embrace to root Smolder or stop an engaging enemy, and attack from your increased range while healing allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness. Cast Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the shield’s range.
Smolder.watch: If Smolder W Achooo! hits, it slows you and adds a growth stack, so dodge by standing behind minions or moving to the side. As Smolder grows, Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath becomes dangerous with damage proportional to maximum health, true damage, and an execute. When Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, avoid the center and don’t follow him into the flames that heal him.

Sona.build: Build magic resistance first against Sona's main damage. If a team fight drags on, healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance adds up, so if your team has no healing reduction, physical damage dealer Senna should buy Executioner's Calling.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward, aim Senna W Last Embrace where she will move, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If there is no angle to land Senna W Last Embrace, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the root.
Sona.escape: After Sona R Crescendo is down, it's a good window to engage with your allies. Root her with Senna W Last Embrace before she activates Sona E Song of Celerity, then approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist.
Sona.fight: Trade briefly when Sona steps forward to apply her aura. After a Senna basic attack, land Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. When you have a chance to secure a kill, use Senna W Last Embrace to stop her from escaping with Sona E Song of Celerity.
Sona.laning: Early on, when Sona is weak and spends a lot of mana, repeat safe pokes to make her spend mana on healing. Senna should collect souls while avoiding minion last hits, but don't risk taking souls in spots threatened by Sona's abilities.
Sona.phase: Early on, Sona has no scaling stacks and spends a lot of mana, so poke her then to keep her subdued. Senna is also fragile early, so collect mist without dying; in the mid game, use your increased attack damage and range. In the late game, Sona's scaling and sustained healing make things increasingly unfavorable as time goes on, so don't let fights drag on.
Sona.teamfight: Approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, but spread out to the left and right to avoid multiple allies getting hit by Sona R Crescendo. From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks; look for a chance to disrupt Sona's positioning with Senna W Last Embrace. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield area.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns all allies in a line, so don't line up with your allies when Sona steps forward. If she suddenly approaches while preparing an empowered basic attack, expect the slow or bonus damage from Sona P Power Chord and create distance.

Swain.build: Swain's main damage abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. If fights drag on because Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension heal him, build healing reduction next.
Swain.combo: After Swain E Nevermove is down, hit Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side. If it's hard to land W, slow him with Q first, then look for W.
Swain.escape: Swain has no mobility or escape ability, so the moment after Swain E Nevermove is down is your chance to engage. Slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and root him with Senna W Last Embrace so your allies can help take him down. Wait until E's returning wave has disappeared before approaching.
Swain.fight: When Swain E Nevermove is down, poke with Senna Q Piercing Darkness's slow and basic attacks, then back off immediately. If you safely hit the same target with a basic attack and Q, you also gain mist from Senna P Absolution. Swain Q Death's Hand is stronger at close range, so don't stay close to keep chaining basic attacks.
Swain.laning: Early on, poke from a safe distance to keep Swain from building stacks. Before moving to collect a soul, check the path of Swain E Nevermove and whether it has been used. Don't risk collecting souls near the enemy turret.
Swain.phase: In the mid game, use Senna's attack damage and range gained from mist. Swain's permanent stacks build over time, so don't insist on taking the same engage angles late game.
Swain.teamfight: When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, don't keep fighting nearby; move out of range and wait for it to end. From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. If Swain engages, root him with Senna W Last Embrace and shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove can root you with its returning wave, then pull you in for a combo. After dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it disappears completely. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with multiple bolts at close range, so keep your distance.

Taric.build: The data does not specify the first item to buy, so it cannot be determined. Taric P Bravado and E Dazzle deal magic damage, so if you build resistance, choose magic resistance.
Taric.combo: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, land a Senna basic attack followed by Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off. When there's a chance to catch him, set up a root with Senna W Last Embrace, then combine Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active, stop attacking, root him with W, and let the duration run out.
Taric.escape: The moment after dodging Taric E Dazzle is your chance to step forward and poke. Taric has no ability to create distance on his own, so if an opportunity to catch him appears, root him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle, keep your distance and poke with Senna basic attacks and Q Piercing Darkness. Don't stay close and take empowered basic attacks from Taric P Bravado; manage your spacing so Taric can't approach his target for basic attacks.
Taric.laning: Early on, collect souls without dying, but watch both Taric E Dazzle and the position of the ally linked to it when moving to collect a soul. When Taric E Dazzle is down, land a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. Give up dangerous souls near the enemy turret.
Taric.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, while Taric's melee basic attack damage is strong, so keep your distance and collect mist. From the mid game onward, Senna's attack damage and range increase with mist, giving her more presence. Late game, use your increased range to land basic attacks first from a safe position.
Taric.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active, stop attacking and root the enemy with Senna W Last Embrace to run out the duration. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within its shield area.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle stuns after a delay, so move to the side when you see its tell. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and wait for it to expire.

Thresh.build: Getting caught by Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh E Flay is the biggest danger, so prioritize tenacity. If you build resistance, choose magic resistance to match the damage from Thresh's abilities.
Thresh.combo: After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and look for Senna W Last Embrace. If Senna W Last Embrace hits, combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers.
Thresh.escape: The moment after Thresh misses Thresh Q Death Sentence is your chance to close the distance. However, he can escape with Thresh W Dark Passage, so land Senna W Last Embrace as you move in during the window when that is down too.
Thresh.fight: Keep your distance while Thresh Q Death Sentence is available, and poke when he steps out to collect a soul or just after he misses Q. From a safe angle, land a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness once each to gain mist, then back off immediately.
Thresh.laning: Early on, focus on collecting mist without getting caught. Before stepping out to collect a soul, check whether Thresh Q Death Sentence has been used, and give up souls in dangerous spots. You can poke Thresh from a distance by using Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a front minion to hit him behind it.
Thresh.phase: Early on, getting caught once is dangerous for Senna, so prioritize spacing and collecting mist against Thresh. From the mid game onward, accumulated mist increases Senna's attack damage and range, creating more chances to poke. Late game, use your increased range to land basic attacks first from a safe position.
Thresh.teamfight: From the back line, Senna should heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use her increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace to root Thresh when he engages. When Thresh W Dark Passage appears, decide whether to finish off the enemy immediately or retreat. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that shields allies.
Thresh.watch: If Thresh Q Death Sentence catches you, it's easy to also get hit by Thresh E Flay, so move sideways to dodge when you see him raise his hook. Also avoid standing on the line between Thresh and his ally to reduce the risk of being pulled in by Thresh E Flay.

Tristana.combo: After Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, land Senna W Last Embrace, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land immediately, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for W.
Tristana.escape: The moment after making Tristana use Tristana W Rocket Jump is your window to close the distance. Land Senna W Last Embrace then to stop her from escaping. Avoid engaging when both Tristana W Rocket Jump and R Buster Shot are ready.
Tristana.fight: From a safe distance, hit with Senna's basic attack followed by Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. If Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, close the distance and look for a chance to catch her with Senna W Last Embrace.
Tristana.laning: Early on, focus on collecting mist without dying, and check whether Tristana W Rocket Jump is ready before stepping out to collect a soul. Avoid Tristana E Explosive Charge's area damage by not standing next to allied minions. Don't take last hits from your allied marksman, but make last hits difficult if you can push the lane toward Tristana's turret.
Tristana.phase: Early on, Senna is weak, so collect mist without overcommitting. From the mid game onward, use your increased attack damage and range to poke. Tristana becomes too difficult to handle late game, so aim to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. Save Senna W Last Embrace for when Tristana jumps in with Tristana W Rocket Jump. If an ally is killed and Tristana W Rocket Jump resets, retreat immediately, and shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is a dash, and its cooldown resets if she gets a takedown. Don't approach carelessly when both Tristana W Rocket Jump and R Buster Shot are ready. Also watch out for the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge near allied minions.

TwistedFate.build: Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, W Pick a Card, and E Stacked Deck all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Armor won't help block damage from these abilities, and movement speed is useful for getting out of their telegraphed areas.
TwistedFate.combo: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's yellow card is down, aim Senna W Last Embrace where the enemy is going. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, slow them first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for the root.
TwistedFate.escape: Once even Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's yellow card has been used, you have a chance to root him with Senna W Last Embrace. If he is holding the yellow card, don't enter his basic attack range.
TwistedFate.fight: Poke just after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's yellow card is used, or while he is holding a blue or red card. Senna's physical damage is effective against Twisted Fate's low armor, so land Senna's basic attack and Q Piercing Darkness to gain mist, then back off immediately. While Twisted Fate R Destiny is down, look for a root with Senna W Last Embrace.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, don't step out to collect souls recklessly; watch both the card color on Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and the position of souls. From a safe angle, land a Senna basic attack followed by Q Piercing Darkness to collect mist, then back off immediately. If Twisted Fate is out of direct range, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a front minion to hit him behind it.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so watch for the stun from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and collect mist without dying. From the mid game onward, mist increases her attack damage and range, giving her more room to poke. Late game, use your increased range to land basic attacks first, but don't step forward and get caught.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. If you see Twisted Fate preparing to move with R Destiny and he is in range, look to interrupt him with Senna W Last Embrace's root. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so allies are within the beam's width, accounting for both its damage and the shield it gives them.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards deals area damage, so dodge where the cards are flying.

Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward first to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals both damage types, and Twitch P Deadly Venom deals true damage, so building only one type of resistance makes it difficult to sufficiently mitigate their damage. Also consider having enough total health to withstand Deadly Venom.
Twitch.combo: When Twitch's position is revealed and you can land Senna W Last Embrace, set up the root with W, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack as the root triggers. If there's no angle for W, slow him first with Q and aim W where Twitch is going.
Twitch.escape: Look to engage when you've dodged the slow from Twitch W Venom Cask and Twitch Q Ambush ends, revealing his position. Twitch has no ability to create distance on his own, so approach with your allies using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist and root him with Senna W Last Embrace.
Twitch.fight: Look for the moment Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position. Slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, root him with Senna W Last Embrace, then land a basic attack and Q before backing off. Don't let the trade drag on while taking several basic attacks.
Twitch.laning: Early on, stay alive and collect Senna P Absolution mist. Before moving to collect a soul, check Twitch's position and whether his key abilities have been used; give up souls in dangerous spots. When you have a safe angle to poke, gain mist with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then back off immediately.
Twitch.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so avoid trades where Twitch lands several basic attacks while you collect mist. From the mid game onward, Senna P Absolution increases her attack damage and range, so poke from a safe distance. Late game, use your increased range, but when Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, account for the fact that his range increases too.
Twitch.teamfight: From the back line, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and use your increased range to land basic attacks. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, don't line up with allies; spread out to the sides. When Twitch Q Ambush ends and reveals his position, coordinate with your allies to target him and root him with Senna W Last Embrace, then shield allies with Senna R Dawning Shadow.
Twitch.watch: Twitch can approach with Twitch Q Ambush, so warn your allies if he is missing and avoid bushes without vision. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands at your feet, leave the area immediately. If you've taken several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate hits.

Varus.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Varus’s main abilities, Q Piercing Arrow and E Hail of Arrows, deal physical damage, and Senna has low armor, so build armor first.
Varus.combo: Thread Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions to set up a root, then combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness with a basic attack when the root triggers. If it’s hard to land Senna W Last Embrace, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then try again to land the root.
Varus.escape: After Varus uses R Chain of Corruption, look for a chance to move in while avoiding the root. Varus has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you close the gap safely, root him with Senna W Last Embrace. You can also approach while sidestepping the path of Varus Q Piercing Arrow as he aims.
Varus.fight: When it’s safe, combine a basic attack with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. If you see Varus take aim with Q Piercing Arrow, sidestep its path and trade while he’s slowed during the aim. When you can close the gap, look for a root with Senna W Last Embrace.
Varus.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting Mist, and avoid taking your allies’ minion last hits. Before collecting a soul, assess positioning and Varus’s ability range, and only step forward after he uses a key ability. Don’t stand in Varus E Hail of Arrows and rely on Senna Q Piercing Darkness to heal you.
Varus.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so getting caught once is dangerous. Prioritize survival and collecting Mist. In the mid game, Mist increases your attack damage and range, giving you more presence. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position. If Varus gets a kill or assist, let his few seconds of enhanced power pass before fighting again.
Varus.teamfight: Stay in the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and land basic attacks with your increased range. Prioritize using Senna W Last Embrace to root enemies who engage. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, move away to avoid its spread. Angle Senna R Dawning Shadow so it damages enemies and shields your allies.
Varus.watch: When Varus W Blighted Quiver has stacked blight, hitting you with an ability triggers damage based on your maximum health. If you’ve taken several basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to expire. Healing is reduced while you’re standing in Varus E Hail of Arrows, so step out before healing with Senna Q Piercing Darkness. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, move away so its tendrils don’t reach you.

Vayne.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Vayne’s damage is mostly physical and Senna has relatively low armor, so build armor first. However, armor doesn’t reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so avoid situations where she can keep attacking you.
Vayne.combo: Once Vayne Q Tumble is used, land Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions or from the side. If it’s hard to hit with Senna W Last Embrace, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then look for a root.
Vayne.escape: The moment after Vayne Q Tumble is used is your chance to close the gap. If Vayne E Condemn is down too, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally from a position where your back isn’t to a wall, then look for Senna W Last Embrace.
Vayne.fight: From a safe distance, land a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. Right after Vayne Q Tumble is used, look for a root with Senna W Last Embrace. Don’t follow too far near a wall, where Vayne E Condemn can hit you.
Vayne.laning: Vayne has low health and armor early, so pressure her with safe trades and disrupt her farming. When collecting a soul, check Vayne’s position and whether she has used her abilities; give up souls in dangerous spots. Collect Mist while avoiding your allied marksman’s minion last hits.
Vayne.phase: Vayne is weak early, but Senna is also in danger if caught once, so trade and collect Mist from a distance where you can survive. In the mid game, use Senna’s increased range from Mist to pressure her and contest objectives and towers. In the late game, it’s hard to withstand Vayne’s damage with defensive stats alone, so avoid extended fights and attack from your increased range.
Vayne.teamfight: Senna E Curse of the Black Mist lets you approach with an ally, but don’t stay in front for long. From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks. Use Senna W Last Embrace to stop Vayne from engaging. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield area.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn can stun you by knocking you into a wall, so don’t stand with your back to one; position toward open space. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals damage based on the target’s maximum health as true damage after repeated hits, so get out of range before she can keep attacking you. When Vayne R Final Hour is active, she briefly becomes invisible after Vayne Q Tumble, so wait for her to reappear before looking for Senna W Last Embrace.

Velkoz.build: Get movement speed first so you can leave the marked areas. Build magic resistance against the magic damage from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, W Void Rift, and E Tectonic Disruption. You can’t reduce the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction or R Life Form Disintegration Ray with resistance, so withstand it with your total health.
Velkoz.combo: If Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally and hit Senna W Last Embrace. If Senna W Last Embrace misses, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and look for the next chance to root him.
Velkoz.escape: The moment after Vel'Koz’s reliable crowd control, E Tectonic Disruption, is used is your chance to engage. Vel'Koz has no mobility ability, so close the gap with an ally using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, then root him with Senna W Last Embrace. Keep in mind that if you get very close, Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back when choosing your engage angle.
Velkoz.fight: When you have a safe trading angle, hit the same target with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. After Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption misses, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally and look for Senna W Last Embrace. Vel'Koz has no mobility ability and low armor, so Senna’s physical damage is effective after you root him.
Velkoz.laning: Early on, account for Senna’s low health and focus on surviving and collecting Mist. Before stepping out to collect a soul, check Vel'Koz’s ability range and whether he has used his abilities. Give up souls in dangerous positions. If you can’t reach Vel'Koz directly, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a front minion to poke him behind it.
Velkoz.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so dodge Vel'Koz’s ability combos while collecting Mist. From the mid game onward, Senna P Absolution increases your attack damage and range, giving you more chances to poke from a safe distance. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack, but don’t step recklessly into Vel'Koz’s crowd control range.
Velkoz.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, prioritize interrupting it with Senna W Last Embrace. When engaging with an ally, approach together with Senna E Curse of the Black Mist. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield area.
Velkoz.watch: You must dodge the split beam from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission too, so don’t only move sideways; move toward Vel'Koz or to a spot behind the beam after it passes. If you’re hit by Vel'Koz W Void Rift and E Tectonic Disruption in succession, the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction triggers. If you have stacks on you, back off and wait them out. When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, look for an angle to interrupt it with Senna W Last Embrace.

Xayah.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Xayah’s damage is mostly physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first.
Xayah.combo: After Xayah R Featherstorm is used, hit Senna W Last Embrace to set up a root. Combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness with a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, slow her first with Q, then look for W.
Xayah.escape: Use Senna W Last Embrace to root her here and coordinate with your ally’s engage.
Xayah.fight: Land one basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. Xayah’s feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long, so keep trades short and change your position.
Xayah.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting Mist. Before stepping out to collect a soul, check the feathers on the ground and whether Xayah has used her abilities. Give up souls in dangerous positions.
Xayah.phase: Senna is weak early, so focus on surviving and collecting Mist while avoiding Xayah’s feather root. From the mid game onward, Mist increases your attack damage and range. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Xayah.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. If Xayah R Featherstorm is still available, be cautious about engaging first with Senna W Last Embrace. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield area.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by at least three returning feathers. If three or more feathers form a line between you and Xayah, sidestep out of that line instead of retreating straight back.

Xerath.build: First, have a way to cleanse or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Movement speed is also important for leaving marked attack areas. If you build resistance, build magic resistance to counter Xerath’s ability damage.
Xerath.combo: When Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down, hit Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions. If it’s hard to land Senna W Last Embrace, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then go for it.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are used is your chance to engage. You can also close the gap while sidestepping Xerath Q Arcanopulse as he charges it. Once you’re close, root him with Senna W Last Embrace to keep him from escaping.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap right after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are used. Within safe range, hit the same target with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. Xerath has relatively low armor, so Senna’s physical damage is effective.
Xerath.laning: Early on, don’t go out of your way to collect souls within Xerath’s range. Collect them when his key abilities are down, and use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a front minion to poke Xerath behind it. Endure while avoiding heavy damage; when Xerath runs out of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Senna is weak early, so avoid Xerath’s long range, stay alive, and collect Mist. From the mid game onward, Senna’s attack damage and range increase, so take safe opportunities to poke more actively. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack while staying in the backline.
Xerath.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks with your increased range. Use Senna W Last Embrace to stop an enemy engage or coordinate with an ally’s engage. When approaching with an ally, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so its shield reaches your allies.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so change direction sideways when you see him charging. Watch your distance so you aren’t hit by both Xerath W Eye of Destruction’s slow and Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun. Start dodging immediately when you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane begin its cast animation.

Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor to help you survive. Yasuo’s main damage is physical and Senna has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots.
Yasuo.combo: When Yasuo approaches, slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then aim Senna W Last Embrace at the spot he’s moving toward. If Senna W Last Embrace hits, combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness with a basic attack when the root triggers. Minions can block Senna W Last Embrace, so cast through a gap or from the side.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his Q stacks reset, creating an opportunity to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can be used again, so go in when you can land your allies’ crowd control and Senna W Last Embrace together before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: First break Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then start trading. From a safe distance, hit once with a basic attack and once with Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so look to trade then.
Yasuo.laning: Keep the wave thin and pushed toward Senna’s side to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can use as stepping stones with E Sweeping Blade. Before stepping out to collect a soul, check Yasuo’s abilities and position, and give up souls in dangerous spots. You can use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a front minion to poke Yasuo behind it.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, and getting caught by Yasuo is dangerous, so focus on surviving and collecting Mist. In the mid game, Mist increases your attack damage and range, so make greater use of safe opportunities to poke. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack, but keep avoiding the range where Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can reach you.
Yasuo.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Save Senna W Last Embrace to root Yasuo when he engages. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so its shield reaches your allies, and use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist when approaching with an ally.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions as stepping stones to reach Senna, so don’t let him close the gap near minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, he can knock you up with a tornado, so watch for the effect and sidestep out of its line. Senna has no ability to escape on her own, so once Yasuo catches her, he can follow up with Yasuo R Last Breath.

Zeri.build: Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zeri Q Burst Fire and W Ultrashock Laser deal mostly physical damage, so build armor first. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Zeri.combo: After Zeri E Spark Surge is used, cast Senna W Last Embrace toward the spot Zeri is moving to. If it’s hard to land Senna W Last Embrace, slow her first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then go for it.
Zeri.escape: The moment after you make Zeri use E Spark Surge is your chance to engage. If Zeri W Ultrashock Laser is down too, use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally, then root her with Senna W Last Embrace. Choose your angle in open terrain so Zeri can’t escape over a wall.
Zeri.fight: Use Zeri’s short basic attack range to land one Senna basic attack and one Senna Q Piercing Darkness from a safe distance, then back off. Right after Zeri E Spark Surge is used, root her with Senna W Last Embrace to create a chance to close the gap. Don’t chase on foot after Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.laning: Early on, getting caught is dangerous for Senna, so focus on surviving and collecting Mist. Check the soul’s position and collect it when Zeri E Spark Surge is down; give up souls in dangerous spots. When you have a safe trading angle, hit the same Zeri with a basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately.
Zeri.phase: Zeri’s kill pressure isn’t high early, but Senna is weak too, so avoid forcing fights. Collect Mist and poke with your range. In the mid game, use the point when Senna’s attack damage and range increase to build a lead before Zeri completes her core items. In the late game, attack first with Senna’s increased range, but don’t recklessly chase Zeri once her mobility is high.
Zeri.teamfight: When using Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with an ally, consider whether you can use Senna W Last Embrace to stop Zeri from engaging. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase; root her with Senna W Last Embrace when she comes in. From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and add basic attacks. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so its shield reaches your allies.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing walls, so when trying to catch her, drive her toward open ground away from walls. When Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, don’t chase her, and keep your distance especially when your health is low to avoid the execute from Zeri P Living Battery.

Ziggs.build: Get movement speed first so you can walk out of marked explosion areas. Build magic resistance rather than armor to protect against Ziggs’s damage.
Ziggs.combo: After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is used, cast Senna W Last Embrace toward the direction Ziggs is moving. Combine Senna Q Piercing Darkness with a basic attack when the root triggers. If Senna W Last Embrace is hard to land, slow him first with Senna Q Piercing Darkness.
Ziggs.escape: The moment after Ziggs uses W Satchel Charge is your chance to engage. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and if Ziggs can cross a wall from his position, check the route on the other side before going in.
Ziggs.fight: Close the gap after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities, especially right after he uses W Satchel Charge. From a safe distance, hit the same target with a basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. Ziggs has relatively low armor, so Senna’s main source of physical damage is effective.
Ziggs.laning: Early on, focus on surviving and collecting Mist, and avoid taking your allies’ minion last hits. Before collecting a soul, check the position of Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield and whether Ziggs has used his key abilities. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, poke from a safe angle. Give up dangerous souls near a tower.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so dodge Ziggs’s poke while collecting Mist. From the mid game onward, Mist increases Senna’s attack damage and range, giving her more presence. In the late game, use your increased range to land the first basic attack from a safe position.
Ziggs.teamfight: From the backline, heal allies with Senna Q Piercing Darkness and land basic attacks with your increased range. Go around paths blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and avoid grouping in one spot with allies to prepare for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb. Use Senna W Last Embrace to stop enemies who engage. Aim Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within its shield area.
Ziggs.watch: If you step on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, its slow makes it easy to get hit by follow-up abilities, so take a path without mines or wait for them to disappear. Be ready for forced movement and an escape while Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available. When Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb’s marked area appears, move out of the center of the explosion even if you can’t dodge it completely.

Zilean.build: Prioritize tenacity to prepare for getting caught by Zilean E Time Warp’s slow and Zilean Q Time Bomb’s stun. Build magic resistance rather than armor to withstand Zilean’s damage.
Zilean.combo: If Senna W Last Embrace hits Zilean, time Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack to land as the root detonates. If you don’t have a clear angle to hit Senna W Last Embrace immediately, slow him with Senna Q Piercing Darkness, then fire the root where Zilean is heading.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility, so the moment after dodging Zilean Q Time Bomb is your chance to close the distance. When engaging, avoid grouping with allies and getting stunned by the same bomb; use Senna E Curse of the Black Mist to approach with them. If the first bomb attaches, stop your engage and move away from your allies.
Zilean.fight: From a safe distance, land a Senna basic attack followed by Senna Q Piercing Darkness to collect Mist, then back off immediately. If you can close the distance after dodging Zilean Q Time Bomb, try to root the immobile Zilean with Senna W Last Embrace.
Zilean.laning: Senna also has low health early, so before going to collect a soul, check whether the position would leave you exposed to a bomb.
Zilean.phase: From mid game onward, Senna gains attack damage and range from Mist. In the late game, use the increased range to attack first from a safe position.
Zilean.teamfight: Stay in the back line, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness to heal allies, and attack with your increased range. Use Senna W Last Embrace to stop enemies who engage. Don’t use abilities while a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift is reviving; target them immediately after they revive. If they’re difficult to take down, target the fragile Zilean instead. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow from an angle that lets its shield reach your allies.
Zilean.watch: When Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches, move away from your allies and get outside the blast radius. Avoid being hit by consecutive bombs while slowed by Zilean E Time Warp.

Zyra.build: Build movement speed first so you can get out of Zyra’s marked areas. If you repeatedly get caught by Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns while taking plant damage, consider tenacity first. Build magic resistance rather than armor.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, land Senna W Last Embrace through a gap between minions, then time Senna Q Piercing Darkness and a basic attack to land as the root detonates. If Senna W Last Embrace doesn’t hit, apply the slow from Senna Q Piercing Darkness first and look for another W opportunity.
Zyra.escape: Dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways is your window to close the distance. Zyra has no ability to create distance herself, so approach from the side without plants and land Senna W Last Embrace.
Zyra.fight: After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots, land a Senna basic attack and Senna Q Piercing Darkness from an area without plants to collect Mist, then back off immediately. When you get a chance to close the distance, root Zyra with Senna W Last Embrace.
Zyra.laning: Early on, focus on managing your distance and collecting Mist. If a soul is within Zyra’s ability range, wait until Zyra E Grasping Roots is down before going to collect it. You can use Senna Q Piercing Darkness on a minion to harass Zyra behind it, but back off immediately after landing a basic attack and Q.
Zyra.phase: Senna is vulnerable if caught early, so focus on collecting Mist without dying. From mid game onward, use your increased attack damage and range; in the late game, attack from a safe position with your range advantage.
Zyra.teamfight: Don’t fight where Zyra has built up plants; move the fight elsewhere. Stay in the back line, use Senna Q Piercing Darkness to heal allies, and attack with your increased range. When Zyra tries to root an ally who is engaging, respond with Senna W Last Embrace. Use Senna R Dawning Shadow so your allies are within the shield’s range.
Zyra.watch: If Zyra E Grasping Roots catches you, Zyra Q Deadly Spines and plant damage can easily follow, so dodge sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, walk out of its area before it knocks you up.
